description: Starts claiming a site for the person: the TXT record or the file that proves they control it. Put either one up, then call mttr_claim_check. A claimed site joins their account: its Search Console figures, visits, citations and rivals, their work board and their progress page. Any key reads a site’s public report without a claim.

site.description: The site, as a domain such as example.com.
